address_forbidden: Addresses in the home network are not allowed
api_key_required: A valid API key is required
api_only: Only the API is available here
app_check_cloudflare: Cloudflare Access protects this address. When connecting the app, enter Client ID and Secret under “Cloudflare Access”.
app_check_home_assistant: This address leads to Home Assistant, not to the app access. Create a separate host name in the tunnel that points to port 8100 of Rezeptplaner (docs/APP-ZUGANG.md).
app_check_home_network: The address points into the home network. The app needs the address from the internet (host name in the Cloudflare tunnel).
app_check_no_key: The address answers without a key – this is not the app access (port 8100).
app_check_not_found: No Rezeptplaner answers at this address. Is the host name entered in the tunnel configuration?
app_check_ok: The app access answers. The app can connect with this address.
app_check_tunnel: The tunnel does not reach Rezeptplaner (error {status}). Check host name and port 8100 in the tunnel configuration.
app_check_unexpected: Unexpected response (status {status}) – this is probably not the app access.
app_check_unreachable: Not reachable – check host name and tunnel.
app_check_web_port: The address leads to the web interface (port 8099). In the tunnel, the host name must point to port 8100.
category_not_in_order: Category {id} is missing – move it to another group first
course_reason_bread: Flour and raising agent without sugar
entry_in_menu: The dish already belongs to a menu
entry_not_sent: This dish hasn't been sent to Bring
format_unsupported: Format version {version} is not supported (expected {min} to {max}) – is Rezeptplaner up to date?
group_not_empty: The group still contains categories – move them or delete them too
image_too_many_pixel: Image is too large (at most {max} megapixels)
image_unsupported: Unsupported image format (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF)
import_category_gone: Category for “{name}” no longer exists – left out
import_expired: Import expired – please upload the file again
import_image_kind: Image type “{name}” is unknown – the image counts as a photo
import_image_missing: Image {name} is missing in the ZIP file
import_image_path: Image path “{name}” is invalid – the image is left out
import_image_unusable: Image {name} is unusable – the recipe is imported without an image
import_images_need_zip: Images are only possible in ZIP files – the image is left out
import_ingredient_negative: Ingredient {n} ({name}): quantity must not be negative
import_ingredient_too_long: Ingredient {n} ({name}): a field is too long
import_no_such_recipe: No such recipe in this import
import_prep_minutes: Prep time must be between 0 and {max} minutes
import_same_title: Same title as recipe {index} of this import
import_servings: Servings are missing or not between {min} and {max}
import_source_url: Source address “{url}” is not a web address and is left out
import_too_many_in_upload: More than {max} recipes in one import
import_total_minutes: Total time must be between 0 and {max} minutes
import_unknown_category: Category “{name}” does not exist – assign it or leave it out
import_web_photo_failed: Photo from {site} could not be loaded
import_web_photo_not_saved: Photo from the source page not saved
import_web_photo_replaces: Photo from {site} will be used (replaces the illustration)
import_yield_unit_too_long: Yield unit is longer than {max} characters
invalid_app_url: Must be an address like https://recipes.example.org
invalid_todo_entity: Must be a to-do list, e.g. todo.shopping
invalid_url: Must start with http:// or https://
merge_into_self: A category cannot be merged with itself
move_to_other_group: The categories must move to a different group
name_length: Name must not be empty and at most {max} characters
no_bring_list: Please choose a Bring list in the settings first
no_course_group: No course group – mark a group as “Course” under Categories
no_recipe_on_page: No recipe found on this page
not_an_image: The address does not return an image
not_utf8: The file is not UTF-8 encoded
not_zip_or_json: Neither a ZIP nor a JSON file
note_required: Without a recipe, enter a note, e.g. “Eating out”
nothing_to_send: Nothing to send in this period
page_unreachable: The page could not be loaded
plan_changed: The plan has changed in the meantime – please reload
planned_into_period: “{title}” moves into the week you have already shopped for, but its ingredients haven't been bought yet.
range_reversed: End must not be before start
recipes_json_missing: recipes.json is missing in the ZIP file
recipes_json_multiple: More than one recipes.json in the ZIP file
status_transferred: “Sent to Bring” is only set by sending
swap_with_self: An entry cannot be swapped with itself
transferred_out_of_period: The ingredients for “{title}” have already been bought and may not keep that long.
upload_not_multipart: Upload not recognized – please choose the files again
web_only_api_keys: Keys can only be managed in the web interface
web_only_categories: Categories can only be managed in the web interface
zip_bad_path: Invalid path in the ZIP file: “{name}”
zip_too_many_entries: Too many entries in the ZIP file (at most {max})
zip_unpacked_too_large: Unpacked too large (at most {max_mb} MB per import)
